sentences.span: The US Info Tech long/short ratio is now 1.5, down from a 2026 peak of 2.14 in early June... leaves hedge funds more than 20 points underweight tech vs. the S&P
sentences.why: GS Armbrust note (27440) separately gives 'lowest level on our record (since 2016)' for the same 1.5 ratio; this file gives the 20-point underweight figure. Both match the sentence exactly.

sentences.span: US Fundamental L/S net leverage rose 2.1 points to 45.4%... The entire increase came from the market going up and from covering index hedges; nobody actually bought anything. Net is still in the 2nd percentile of the past five years
sentences.why: Direct match on mechanism (price appreciation + hedge covering, not buying) and the 2nd percentile/five-year figure.

sentences.span: retail net bought $1.6 billion of Nvidia on Thursday alone, nearly 10x the demand for the next most-bought stock... Retail was more engaged, buying an estimated ~$25B over the past week through Thursday
sentences.why: All three figures (($25B weekly, $1.6B NVDA Thursday, ~10x next stock) match Morgan Stanley's QDS data as reported.

sentences.span: the stock market spent the week pricing positioning while the bond market priced the Fed
sentences.why: Vague paraphrase but the stance (bond market priced something distinct from what stocks priced) is a bank's stance (Goldman) stated in the source.

sentences.span: We continue to prefer hyperscalers to the high-beta AI players, favoring balance-sheet strength and free-cash-flow durability
sentences.why: JPMorgan (confirmed via meta.json) states exactly this preference.

sentences.span: Nvidia (NVDA) announced that its co-founder and only CEO in 33 years has resigned, effective immediately... CFO Colette Kress takes over as interim CEO (while keeping the CFO job)
sentences.why: Exact match on resignation timing and Kress's dual role.

sentences.span: Kress, as both interim CEO and CFO, presents Q3 results on Nov 17... Somebody will ask her about the $500 billion [financing platform]
sentences.why: Matches the $500bn commitments and the call framing.

sentences.span: AI-related high yield spreads have blown out to roughly 425bp against about 265bp for non-AI BB/B paper... investment grade tenant wraps only become effective on completion
sentences.why: Attributed to Goldman's Miriam Wheeler in source; matches spread figures, no-new-deals-since-September claim, and the completion-contingent guarantee mechanic.

sentences.span: we have seen the all-time widest print on AAAs (200)... We believe this weakness is primarily driven by technical factors, rather than fundamental concerns over the thematic backdrop
sentences.why: Morgan Stanley (confirmed via meta.json) states exactly the 200bp AAA print and the supply/technical-not-verdict framing.

sentences.span: We take off our long-held underweight on high-quality hyperscalers, but would add risk selectively at the long-end
sentences.why: Morgan Stanley (confirmed via meta.json) states this removal of the underweight directly.

sentences.span: consensus EPS rose by about 3 log points... while P/E multiples contracted by about 37 log points overall... for these stocks, the de-rating accounts for more than the entire price decline... 30 Sep to cut-off... 5 Nov 2026 close for all others
sentences.why: Morgan Stanley decomposition exactly matches the Sept 30-Nov 5 window and the valuation-driven finding.

sentences.span: US and Europe moved from the middle of their ranges to the bottom quintile (median percentiles 17 and 13). Japan de-rated most, from the 82nd to the 28th percentile, even though every Japanese member saw flat or higher FY2 estimates... Asia/EM... 7 of its 26 members (27%) saw FY2 consensus cut by more than 0.5%
sentences.why: The quintile/82nd-to-28th figures are correct, but 'no member seeing lower estimates' universalizes a Japan-only qualifier ('every Japanese member saw flat or higher FY2 estimates'); the same document states 7 of 26 Asia/EM members DID see estimate cuts, directly contradicting the sentence's claim as stated.

sentences.span: We expect Eurozone earnings to grow 15% next year and remain positive on the region's equities. [UBS]; Raise MSCI Europe target to 3030 (+15% upside) [Morgan Stanley, 27326]
sentences.why: Both bank claims verified verbatim in their respective source files.

sentences.span: France's CAC-40 was outperforming our basket of AI-winners over the last 12mths... European banks have now outperformed the mighty 'Mag7' over 1yr, 2yrs, 3yrs, 4yrs & 5yrs
sentences.why: Goldman Sachs (Mark Wilson) states both comparisons exactly as paraphrased.

sentences.span: Bitcoin is once again trading below Strategy's average purchase price... Funding turned negative on Binance, OKX and Bybit on November 13... traders are increasingly paying to be short
sentences.why: Direct match on all elements including the exact date and exchanges.
